title: Crypto Analytics — Real-Time Market Monitoring
description: DE Zoomcamp capstone: VWAP time-series + volume distribution by symbol. Powered by Kafka → PySpark → ClickHouse.

panels.title: VWAP Over Time — Price Distribution Across Time
panels.description: Volume-Weighted Average Price per symbol over the selected time window. Each line is one trading pair. Shows how prices distribute and evolve in real time. (Zoomcamp: time-series distribution panel)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, product_id AS metric, vwap_usd AS value FROM crypto.candles_1m WHERE window_start >= $__fromTime AND window_start <= $__toTime ORDER BY window_start ASC

panels.title: Total Trade Volume by Symbol — Distribution Across Symbols
panels.description: Total volume traded per symbol over the selected window. Shows which coins are most actively traded — the distribution of activity across categories/symbols. (Zoomcamp: categorical distribution panel)

targets.rawSql: SELECT product_id, sum(volume_qty) AS total_volume FROM crypto.candles_1m WHERE window_start >= $__fromTime AND window_start <= $__toTime GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_volume DESC

panels.title: Volatility by Symbol (Rolling Std Dev)
panels.description: Price volatility (standard deviation within each 1-minute window) summed per symbol. Higher = more price swings.

targets.rawSql: SELECT product_id, avg(volatility_usd) AS avg_volatility FROM crypto.live_metrics WHERE window_start >= $__fromTime AND window_start <= $__toTime GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY avg_volatility DESC

panels.title: Volume Spike Alerts
panels.description: Recent alerts where trading volume exceeded the rolling baseline by 2× or more.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS Time, product_id AS Symbol, severity AS Severity, round(spike_ratio, 2) AS `Spike Ratio`, round(volume_qty, 4) AS Volume, round(baseline_volume_qty, 4) AS Baseline FROM crypto.alerts WHERE window_start >= $__fromTime ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 50

list.name: symbol
list.label: Symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM crypto.live_metrics ORDER BY product_id
